steps.en: A held notice keeps being sent to the agency for its owner details
steps.id: Notice yang ditahan terus dikirim ke agency untuk data pemiliknya
steps.why_en: Resend timing follows the schedule, not the set wait days, and has been inconsistent.
steps.why_id: Waktu kirim ulang mengikuti jadwal, bukan lama tunggu yang ditetapkan, dan pernah tidak konsisten.

steps.en: Owner details and address are saved as soon as the agency returns them
steps.id: Data pemilik dan alamat disimpan begitu agency mengembalikannya

steps.en: The hold is lifted once the owner details are available
steps.id: Penahanan dicabut setelah data pemilik tersedia
steps.why_en: The hold is lifted on its due date by a daily job, not when the details arrive.
steps.why_id: Penahanan dicabut pada tanggal jatuh tempo oleh job harian, bukan saat data tiba.

steps.en: The notice goes back into normal processing
steps.why_en: It resumes only after another cycle, and many notices got stuck without owner details.
steps.why_id: Notice lanjut hanya setelah satu siklus lagi, dan banyak notice tersangkut tanpa data pemilik.
